current_state.target: Brief-listed Rijksoverheid subdomains, sitearchief surfaces, and PRO Next.js data layer

recon_enumeration: zoeken.bigregister.nl is an Angular SPA. Its public bundle exposes same-origin public-search/reference-data routes. One public professional-groups GET returned intended register metadata; one invalid zero registration number returned 400 bigNumberInvalid. No valid-number lookup or enumeration was performed.

mijn.bigregister.nl is an Angular authentication portal with DigiD/eIDAS/BIG-login boundaries. Anonymous GET /api/userinfo and /api/session both returned 401 with only redirectUrl; no authentication submission or SSO traversal was performed.

toezichtdocumenten.igj.nl is Mendix/Dojo. The root and harmless query returned the bootstrap shell. login.html and login.js showed a username/password POST to xas/; stopped without submitting credentials.
rijksoverheid.sitearchief.nl uses Archiefweb PHP/JS. The real archive search calls POST search.php, so the GET-only task could not submit it. A harmless root query was not reflected.
www.sitearchief.nl serves an archive/service index with old WordPress snapshot paths and many Archiefweb/other sitearchief links. These unbriefed or third-party hosts were recorded and not requested.

www.rijksoverheid.nl and www.bigregister.nl are Next.js 16.2.12 App Router/Turbopack sites. HTML uses RSC self.__next_f, not legacy __NEXT_DATA__; no buildId, valid /_next/data path, or first-party /api path was found in the selected HTML/chunks. Search markers returned 404 and were unicode-escaped in RSC data.
english.igj.nl, english.ilent.nl, and english.bigregister.nl matched the shared PRO Next.js build in one GET each.

exploit_foothold.result: None. No write, authentication attempt, brute force, SSO completion, valid register-record lookup, sequential ID access, POST search, exploitation, or pivot.

failed_attempts_constraints: Three large public JS responses reached the 1 MiB capture cap (curl exit 63); their saved prefixes were grepped locally and no further copies were fetched.
Archive search and Mendix login are POST-driven, prohibited by the brief, and therefore remain unsubmitted.
The PRO implementation has no legacy buildId in HTML, so a valid /_next/data/<buildId>/... JSON request could not be constructed.
www.sitearchief.nl contains broad links to other archive tenants and Archiefweb; scope inheritance was not assumed.
unexplored_surface: Valid BIG-number public record responses were deliberately not queried; sequential IDs were not enumerated.
Authenticated portal APIs, registration, OTP/email validation, DigiD/eIDAS/eHerkenning, and all POST/write flows remain deliberately untested.

advieswijzer.bigregister.nl, other *.sitearchief.nl tenants, archiefweb.eu, and big-app-webservice.dev.local were discovered but not requested because they were absent from the brief or third-party/development references.
considerations_for_next_agent: Do not repeat these 35 GETs. A future explicitly authorized POST-capable wave would be required to assess Archiveweb search reflection or Mendix authentication behavior. Any valid BIG register lookup should remain a single known-public record, never enumeration.

compliance.scope: Only the ten brief-allowlisted hosts were requested. oefenexamensnt2.nl and www.werkenbijdji.nl received zero requests.
compliance.prohibited_activity: No DoS, brute force, social engineering, malware, write, POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, credential submission, authentication bypass, or out-of-scope request.
